part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in `isAnchorBrokenLink` in packages/docusaurus/src/server/brokenLinks.ts:124 — the target-page lookup in `collectedLinks` only tried the exact pathname (and its decoded form), so `/docs/test#abc` was reported as a broken anchor when the page was collected as `/docs/test/` (and vice versa).

The fix restores the trailing-slash-tolerant lookup, trying `addTrailingSlash`/`removeTrailingSlash` variants of both the raw and decoded pathname, plus the straightforward anchor check. The dead obfuscated code in that function was removed accordingly.

Validation: all 35 tests in `brokenLinks.test.ts` pass (including the previously failing "accepts valid non-strict link with anchor"), `tsc --noEmit` and `eslint` are clean.
